# Atlas Nusantara

> Explore Indonesia's places, local food, plants, wildlife and weather through an interactive regional atlas in 13 languages.

Atlas Nusantara is maintained by [ygrip](https://github.com/ygrip). It combines public reference catalogues and dated environmental observations where available. Sources, licenses, coverage and timestamps matter: a missing record is not evidence that no event occurred. This is not an emergency alert service. Follow official BMKG and BNPB advisories for safety decisions.

## Key pages

- [Atlas](https://nusantara.readynaz.com/): Indonesia's regions, maps, places, food and biodiversity.
- [Province directory](https://nusantara.readynaz.com/#provinces): browse provinces and their regional details.
- [Sources and terms](https://nusantara.readynaz.com/terms#sources): source attribution, licensing and limitations.
- [Privacy](https://nusantara.readynaz.com/privacy): local preferences, optional location, notifications and advertising.
